_doc: Composition rules — JSON-driven post-pass for the Element Manifest.
Per format we declare safe-zone reservations and per-composition cluster rules.
Each rule can set BOTH cta_anchor and cta_gap_above_em — the applier prefers
the anchor when it leaves a sane visual gap (≤250px to subhead) and no overlap;
otherwise it falls back to gap_above. This lets a single rule work for both
short and long headlines without producing a 'floating CTA' look.

1200x628._doc: Leaderboard 1.91:1 — LinkedIn link share, generic banner.

default.description: Column-aligned text-stack with snug em-based gaps. CTA hugs the subhead.

hero_overlay.description: Full-bleed visual with text overlay. Column-aligned stack.

text_leading.description: Classic Z-pattern: left text, right visual.

bottom_anchor.description: CTA on the Z-terminal. Anchor preferred; falls back to gap when stack tall.

1080x1080._doc: Instagram feed square. Center or left-stack. Anchor rarely useful here.

centered_mockup_with_headline.description: Centered hero. Subhead + CTA centered on headline.

1080x1350._doc: Instagram feed portrait 4:5. Disclaimer position is managed by preventDisclaimerOverlap, so we don't reserve a fixed bottom band here (a fixed band caused clamp to drag the CTA up into the subhead).

default.description: Column-aligned, gap-positioned CTA. Stack flows naturally; disclaimer-guard handles the legal text placement.

1200x1200._doc: LinkedIn large square — same family as 1080x1080.

1500x500._doc: Ultra-wide 3:1 cover. Only 500px tall — vertical stack can't fit headline+subhead+cta+disclaimer. Switches to a HORIZONTAL split: text-stack on the left, CTA anchored right-center.

default.description: Horizontal split — text-stack left, CTA centered on right edge.

1920x1080._doc: HD landscape — YouTube card, big leaderboard. Extra breathing room.

default.description: Column-aligned stack with slightly more generous em gaps.

1080x1920._doc: Instagram / TikTok / Snap story 9:16. Top 220px and bottom 220px reserved for platform UI overlays — anything in those bands is invisible or clipped.

default.description: Anchor preferred (CTA above platform bottom UI), with gap fallback for tall headlines.

centered.description: Centered story. No CTA anchoring — gap-based so stack stays cohesive.
